sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:222

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:222:1
items.html:
Its AA is in the secret of its VAK alone, and the GAR of these VAK, which are HGT, remain revealed, and its three lower ones are clothed in the VAK of AVI. In order to understand these words of the ARI, you must remember the rule that every discernment in the lower takes only from the discernment opposite it in the upper. And it is known that all of BYA is nothing but the discernment of the TNHY of the ZAT of Nekudim, and therefore the Partzufim of BYA cannot take anything from the discernment of the Chazeh [chest] and above of the five Partzufim of Atzilut; rather, each Partzuf of the Partzufim of Beria takes from the discernment of the TNHY of the Partzuf opposite it in Atzilut: Atik takes from the discernment of the NHY of Atik of Atzilut, and AA of Beria takes from the discernment of the NHY of AA of Atzilut, and AVI of Beria from the NHY of AVI of Atzilut, and likewise YESHSUT and ZON from the NHY of YESHSUT and ZON of Atzilut. Such that only the discernment of the feet of Atzilut shines in Beria, for the feet of Atik shine to Atik of Beria, and the feet of AA to AA, etc., as the ARI wrote in Etz Chaim, Gate 42, Chapter 13. Such that the coupling of the five Partzufim of Beria is made in the Nukva of Atzilut, in the clothing of Tevuna; however, the coupling draws the illumination of the feet from all the five Partzufim of Atzilut, and passes them to the world of Beria. As is written in Beit Sha’ar HaKavanot, page 74, the passage beginning “And know.” And in Etz Chaim, Gate 42, Chapter 13, mentioned above.
However, according to this, how does the ARI say here that the HGT NHY of AA of Beria came out, and likewise in AVI of Beria, and all the more so in YESHSUT and ZON, which came out in complete ten Sefirot, which contradicts the aforementioned Etz Chaim, Gate 42, which says that they take only the discernment of the feet of the five Partzufim of Atzilut alone? And the matter is that when they take the discernment of the NHY of Atik, behold, the HGT of AA clothe there upon these NHY of Atik, for the NHY of Atik are always clothed in the HGT of AA, and therefore there is here also the HGT of AA, that is, in respect of their clothing Atik; and likewise when they take the NHY of AA, behold, the VAK of AVI and the whole level of YESHSUT and ZON, which came out through the coupling of AVI, who descended to the place of the NHY of AVI, clothe there upon the TNHY of AA; therefore they all come together with the NHY of AA, for they all clothe him there from the Chazeh and below.
Thus, on the one hand they take only the discernment from the Chazeh and below of the five Partzufim of Atzilut, but on account of the descent of AVI to the discernment of their own NHY, which are called YESHSUT, YESHSUT then gained, through the coupling of AVI on the screen of phase two, and through their inclusion together, the whole part of the Partzuf from the Chazeh and above of AVI, whereby the NHY of AVI expanded into a complete level, HBD HGT NHY; and likewise YESHSUT and ZON who are included in them — although previously there had been in them only NHY, they now received, through the descent of AVI to them, all ten Sefirot. And through this you will understand what he concludes there in Etz Chaim, Gate 42, Chapter 13, and these are his words: Just as the light of the feet themselves passes, so the whole Guf [body] entirely passes through the feet and shines below. End of quote. That is, as explained, that this is done because of the descent of AVI to their own NHY.
And it is found that in truth there should have been from AA only the discernment of the TNHY of AA alone, for the coupling and the expansion of NHY into ten Sefirot was made only in AVI, who descended to the place of the TNHY of AA, and there is no discernment of HGT there at all; however, the HGT of AA came with the TNHY of Atik, since they clothe them in Atzilut. And through this you will understand what the ARI says here, that the HGT of Atik became a revealed head, which means in the discernment of Radla [the unknown head] that became a revealed head in Atzilut; and likewise he says explicitly below that the Malchut of Atzilut that became Atik of Beria is clothed in these HGT of AA. And likewise in Etz Chaim, Gate 47, Chapter 6, he says that these HGT became Atik, and are still regarded as the discernment of Atzilut; study it there well. Thus the HGT of AA serve the Rosh [head] of Atik, and this is for the aforementioned reason, for from the side of the Partzuf of AA himself they cannot come here in Beria, for Beria has no part except in the TNHY of AA, and not from his Chazeh and above, but they were drawn with the NHY of Atik; and therefore also now they became only a garment for Atik, in the secret of Radla, called a revealed head, to indicate that it is not joined to the discernment of the five Partzufim of Beria, and they are still regarded as the discernment of the world of Atzilut, for AA of Beria has no part in HGT, as explained.
And we learn that all these five Partzufim in Beria, AA and AVI and YESHSUT and ZON, behold, all of them are of equal level. For the HGT of AA that became a garment for Atik is the discernment of a revealed head, and is not counted among the five Partzufim of Beria. And it is found that the five Partzufim of Beria begin from the NHY of AA, upon which the VAK of AVI clothes at an equal level, for they descended to their NHY, which are YESHSUT, who clothe the NHY of AA, that is, from his Chazeh and below. Also YESHSUT and ZON clothed one within another and became of equal level, as the ARI writes below. And it is found that the VAK of AVI is equal with the NHY of AA, and with YESHSUT and ZON, so that all these five Partzufim are at a truly equal level, and all are equal with the TNHY of AA. And this is what the ARI says in Sha’ar HaGilgulim [Gate of Reincarnations], Introduction 11, that all the five Partzufim of Beria correspond to one Partzuf in the world of Atzilut, that is, to the Partzuf YESHSUT, who clothes from the Chazeh and below of AA, except that within it are the NHY of AA and the VAK of AVI, and upon it the ZON clothe at an equal level, as above.
